claim: Compute Savings Plans automatically apply to your EC2 instance usage regardless of instance family, instance size, Region, operating system, or tenancy, and they also apply to your Fargate and Lambda usage.

evidence.quote: Compute Savings Plans** provide the most flexibility and prices that are up to 66% off of On-Demand rates. These plans automatically apply to your EC2 instance usage, regardless of instance family (for example, m5, c5, etc.), instance size (for example, c5.large, c5.xlarge, etc.), Region (for example, us-east-1, us-east-2, etc.), operating system (for example, Windows, Linux, etc.), or tenancy (for example, Dedicated, default, Dedicated Host). They also apply to your Fargate and Lambda usage.
